dimensions.name: Implicit-default silent model swap on SWE_DEFAULT_RUNTIME deployments
dimensions.review_prompt: Deployments that set SWE_DEFAULT_RUNTIME=open_code or codex without any model env var (SWE_DEFAULT_MODEL/AI_MODEL/HARNESS_MODEL) previously received 'sonnet' for planning reasoners via _default_planning_model()'s implicit sonnet fallback. The new runtime-aware cascade returns the runtime's base default (e.g., deepseek-v4-flash-0731 for open_code, gpt-5.5 for codex) instead. Verify: (1) whether this silent behavioral shift is gated behind a feature flag or config opt-in, (2) whether all affected test assertions in test_model_config.py and test_runtime_aware_model_default.py have been updated to match the new contract, and (3) whether production Docker deployments baking SWE_DEFAULT_RUNTIME without a model override will observe unexpected planning-model changes post-deploy.

rationale: _default_planning_model() at schemas.py:804 now calls _default_runtime() when no runtime arg is passed, replacing the old implicit 'sonnet' fallback with a runtime-gated base default. The docstring documents this as intentional (lines 783-788), but it is a silent behavioral change for any deployment that sets SWE_DEFAULT_RUNTIME without an explicit model env var — those environments will see their planning reasoners switch from sonnet to a runtime-native model with no config change. The existing test_no_provider_env_defaults_to_sonnet in test_model_config.py:59 still passes only because it does not set SWE_DEFAULT_RUNTIME; adding that env var would expose the new behavior and potentially break production expectations. No feature flag or migration guard was found to phase this in.
